description_short: Exports your world to a .coimap file you can explore as an interactive map in the browser. Read-only, and safe to add to or remove from an existing save.
description_long: CoiMapper Exporter Writes your world to a .coimap file that the coi-mapper web app renders as a fast, zoomable 2D map of your whole base. What it exports - Terrain heights, surface materials and ocean - Every placed building, with its real footprint, prototype and state - Prototype names, categories and colours How to use 1. Load a save. The mod exports once on load. 2. Save the game at any time to refresh the map. 3. Open the exported file in the web app. Exports are written to %APPDATA%/Captain of Industry/CoiMapper/, named after the save. Safety This mod is read-only. It registers no prototypes, adds no serialisable state and changes no gameplay, so it can be added to and removed from existing saves freely. A failed export is caught and logged rather than interrupting the game. Open source MIT licensed. Source, changelog and the web app are on GitHub.
